why: PROTECTION, ON TOP OF draw-v1. deck-audit reads two protection copies (Greaves, Boots) against five to seven, on a deck whose whole plan sits on one three-drop commander every table will point removal at. THE GOLDFISH CANNOT SEE THIS AXIS -- nothing is ever removed there -- so the objective is the CONTROL: the clock must hold, and the audit's count is the evidence for the change. In: Deflecting Swat (free with the commander out, redirects the removal or the wipe's one target), Mithril Coat (flash, attaches itself to a legendary on entry: instant-speed indestructible for Ingris), Feign Death (one mana, she comes back tapped rather than to the command zone). Out: Glistening Oil, Phyresis and Tainted Strike -- infect grants on a list where twenty-one creatures already carry infect, which the 55-card leave-one-out sweep priced at +0.004 each (nothing). Corpus sweep in identity: the free-with-a-commander pair is Swat and Deadly Rollick; the dies-return family is Feign Death / Undying Malice / Supernatural Stamina / Not Dead After All / Malakir Rebirth (in); the equipment is Mithril Coat / Champion's Helm / Whispersilk Cloak / Darksteel Plate.
